expedition_event_void_scan_desc: Deep-space arrays swept the sector in silence. No exploitable signatures remained on the scope.
expedition_event_mineral_deposit_desc: Surface probes locked onto a shallow ore vein. Extraction teams marked the vein for rapid harvest before the window closed.
expedition_event_fuel_cache_desc: A drifting refueling pod surfaced on long-range scan. Its cells still held usable charge after decades adrift.
expedition_event_debris_salvage_desc: Hull fragments spun through the void in a slow arc. The fleet sorted the wreckage and recovered usable scrap metal.
expedition_event_nav_interference_desc: Ionized storm fronts scrambled the navigation matrix. The fleet had to compute a longer return vector through unstable space.
expedition_event_distress_beacon_desc: A fractured distress pulse cut through the static. Following the signal, the fleet found a drifting supply pod venting heat into the void.
expedition_event_sensor_glitch_desc: Anomalous readings bloomed on every screen, then collapsed on approach. Instrument noise — nothing more.
expedition_event_ancient_stash_desc: A sealed precursor cache resisted every scan until the fleet cracked its lock. Unknown technology, unknown origin — but the contents were real.
expedition_event_pirate_encounter_desc: Hostile signatures emerged from a debris shadow. Raiders closed in before the fleet could withdraw from the sector.
expedition_report_pirate_win: Your fleet repelled the pirate ambush.
expedition_report_pirate_loss: Your fleet broke contact under heavy fire.
expedition_event_ion_storm_desc: Charged particle fronts swept the sector. Navigation computers recalculated a longer, safer return corridor through the turbulence.
expedition_event_ancient_minefield_desc: Dormant proximity mines woke as the fleet passed. Several hulls took damage before the formation cleared the grid.
fleet_expedition_report_ion_storm_delay: Return delayed by %(seconds)s s due to ion storm.
expedition_report_minefield_damage: The fleet crossed dormant mines — hull damage without hostile contact.
expedition_event_lost_container_desc: Long-range sensors locked onto an old supply container tumbling through the void. Its seals still held — barely.
expedition_event_abandoned_convoy_desc: Destroyed freighters drifted in formation, cargo bays venting into space. The fleet salvaged what the convoy no longer needed.
expedition_event_ancient_derelict_desc: An immense precursor hull crossed the fleet's path in silence. Unknown design, unknown crew — but parts of it were still worth taking home.
expedition_event_spatial_rift_desc: A tear in local space-time shimmered ahead of the fleet. Sensor returns doubled, then vanished — whatever lay beyond did not obey normal physics.
expedition_event_time_anomaly_desc: Chronometric drift spiked across the formation. Clocks disagreed, logs contradicted themselves — the sector had lost a coherent timeline.
expedition_event_ancient_beacon_desc: A precursor beacon ignited on approach, broadcasting coordinates to a cache no chart had ever recorded. The signal was older than the colony itself.
fleet_expedition_report_spatial_rift_amp: Spatial distortion amplified the recovered cargo beyond normal limits.
fleet_expedition_report_spatial_rift_del: The rift collapsed behind the fleet — return delayed by %(seconds)s s.
fleet_expedition_report_time_anomaly_dil: Time dilation stretched the expedition — return delayed by %(seconds)s s.
fleet_expedition_report_time_anomaly_com: Chrono compression registered on sensors — no measurable return gain in this phase.
fleet_expedition_report_ancient_beacon: The beacon unlocked a sealed cache from a forgotten age.
expedition_report_legendary_time_anomaly: Chrono compression registered — no return gain in this phase.
expedition_report_legendary_ancient_beac: The beacon unlocked a sealed cache from a forgotten age.

desc_metal_mine: Extracts Ferronit from your planet’s crust. Higher levels significantly increase production output.
desc_crystal_mine: Harvests valuable Crytite from deep veins. Essential for high-tech modules and research.
desc_solar_plant: Large collector arrays that convert starlight into Aetherion energy to power your colony.
desc_research_lab: The core of your scientific progress. Higher levels speed up research and unlock new technologies.
desc_academy: Speeds up all research times by 5% per Academy level. Requires Research Lab level 2.
desc_metal_storage: Expands storage capacity for Ferronit and prevents production stops caused by full depots.
desc_crystal_storage: Specialized silos for Crytite. Crucial for financing large high-tech projects.
desc_fuel_storage: Stores produced Fuel Cells. Expands capacity by factor 1.8 per level (base 100,000). Scales with storage tech and Terraformer.
desc_command_center: Unlocks military and late-game buildings. Reduces Nano-Assembly build time by 25% per level.
desc_orbital_shipyard: Production engine for ships and orbital defense. Unlocks ship construction, raises global yard capacity (3^level per cycle), reduces cycle times by 10% per level, and scales effective parallel output per unit — fast hulls use more capacity than heavy haulers.
desc_shipyard: Unlocks ship construction. Higher levels unlock better hull classes and raise yard capacity.
shipyard_hint: Build ships for scouting, hauling, combat, and expeditions. The orbital shipyard sets cycle time, total yard capacity, and effective parallel output per hull type. Applies to the active planet only.

fleet_shipyard_link_hint: Build new ships at the Orbital Shipyard.
desc_defense_factory: Unlocks defense units and specializations (level per unit type). Does not produce on its own — build speed and parallel capacity come from the orbital shipyard.
defense_hint: Build stationary turrets and shields to protect your colony. Unlocks via the Defense Factory — production capacity and cycle time come from the orbital shipyard. Active planet only.
defense_queue_hint: Maximum 3 orders. Cancelling refunds %(refund)s%% of resources.
defense_buildable_subtitle: Unlocked — production via orbital yard capacity
defense_locked_subtitle: Requires a higher Defense Factory level or research

defense_no_buildable: Build a Defense Factory first or upgrade its level.
defense_sentinel_turret_desc: Light planetary gun effective against scouts and light fighters.
defense_plasma_arc_desc: Medium energy cannon with strong penetration against couriers and interceptors.
defense_ion_bastion_desc: Heavy fortification against combat ships and haulers.
defense_flak_array_desc: Multi-launcher battery with rapid fire against small and medium targets.
defense_pulse_barrier_desc: Energy shield that absorbs incoming fire before hull damage.
defense_orbital_shield_desc: Powerful orbital shield generator protecting the entire colony.
desc_barracks: Training grounds for crews and marines. Foundation for a strong military presence and fleet crews.
desc_radar_array: Adds +2 galaxy scan range per level (bonus prepared — activation follows). Espionage runs separately via probe missions.
desc_shield_generator: Late-game building (CC level 4, Defense Factory level 2). Planetary shields are in preparation — build turrets under Defense.
desc_terraformer: The Terraformer creates safe infrastructure zones — not extra building slots, but usable industrial and storage capacity. Increases Ferronit and Crytite storage by 5% per level. Stacks with storage buildings and Storage Technology.
desc_nanofactory: Reduces all building build times by 30% per level. Stacks with Construction Optimization and Research Lab.
desc_geothermal_nexus: +3% solar output per level. +2 max level for mines, solar, fuel cell plant and storage per geothermal level.
desc_planet_core_nexus: Endgame: +1 max level for Ferronit Mine, Crytite Extractor, Solar Collectors and Fuel Cell Plant per level (base max 50). Storage caps only via Geothermal Nexus.
desc_energy_tech: Optimizes conduits, converters and reactors. Reduces the energy consumption of your mines by 5% per level. The effect scales with every additional research level.
desc_mining_tech: +10% Ferronit production and +4% Crytite production per level. Stacks with Drone Optimization.
desc_buildtime_tech: Reduces build and research times multiplicatively by 3% per level (× 0.97^level). Scales without cap and multiplies with Nano-Assembly, Command Center, Lab, and Academy.
desc_storage_tech: Increases Ferronit and Crytite storage capacity by 25% per level. Stacks with storage buildings and Terraformer.
desc_research_drones_tech: Improved mining and service drones maximize uptime and precision. Adds an extra production bonus per level.
desc_research_navigation_tech: Expands parallel fleets and shortens jumps. Levels 3/5/8/10 unlock slots; every 3 levels after 10 adds another slot. Requires Research Lab 3 and Drone Optimization 2.
desc_research_engine_tech: High-performance drives with cryogenic cooling increase thrust for large fleets and reduce energy losses.
desc_research_weapon_tech: Advanced laser, projectile and energy weapons considerably increase your fleets’ firepower.
desc_research_armor_tech: Layered composite armor and adaptive material design enhance the survivability of your ships.
desc_research_shield_tech: Advanced shield generators, modulators and field amplifiers harden your defenses against concentrated fire.
desc_drone_tech: +3% Ferronit and Crytite production per level. Stacks with Metal Refinement.
